title: repro compare's eval_passed counts a frozen row that was none at the start and is still none with no answer found as passed, so an instance that found nothing ties one that found every answer
goal: bench_repro.frozen_pass passes a frozen row whose answer is not found only when its verdict gained on the start commit's, so a row none at the start and none at the end, and a row with an unknown start verdict, no longer pass, and eval_passed reads only the answers gained

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_repro as b

rows = {('none', 'none', False): b.frozen_pass('none', 'none', False), ('bogus', 'none', False): b.frozen_pass('bogus', 'none', False)}
print('rows that pass with no answer found:', rows)
sys.exit(0 if not any(rows.values()) else 1)
